body_text: Play-based does not mean no academics. We use play as one of the most powerful ways young children learn.

items.title: Mathematics
items.text: Blocks, cooking, water, patterns, sorting and measuring.

items.title: Language
items.text: Storytelling, conversations, songs and dramatic play.

items.title: Science
items.text: Planting, observing insects, mixing materials and exploring shadows.

items.title: Social-Emotional
items.text: Collaborative play, friendships and solving problems together.

items.title: Creativity
items.text: Drawing, painting, clay, music, movement and drama.

title: From Play to Action
text: Our educators observe, listen, notice interests, plan provocations, ask thoughtful questions and document learning. In a play-based classroom the teacher is never absent. She becomes a more thoughtful guide.
